# Rating Guard

> Rating Guard is an online service that helps businesses assess potentially policy-relevant Google reviews, organize supporting evidence, and manage review-related workflows.

## What the service does

- Provides tools to scan and analyze Google review information.
- Helps users organize evidence and prepare policy-based reports.
- Supports review-management workflows for business teams.
- Google independently evaluates reports and makes all decisions about its review policies. Rating Guard cannot remove reviews or guarantee a result.

## Pricing

Current pricing is not stated in this file. Contact Rating Guard for current plans and availability.

## Locations and availability

Rating Guard is an online service at https://ratingguard.online. This site does not claim physical offices or confirmed service coverage in specific countries.
